text:
I dreamed that you were taking me

along a white path,

through the green countryside,

toward the blue of the sierras,

toward the blue mountains,

on a serene morning.


I felt your hand in mine,

your companion's hand,

your child's voice in my ear

like a new bell,

like a virgin bell

of a spring dawn.


They were your voice and your hand,

in dreams, so true!...


Live, hope, who knows

what the earth swallows!

translation.title: I Dreamed That You Were Taking Me
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the dream-walk, companion hand, and final appeal to hope.
